root_text:
Symptoms of the HMPV-1 virus are the same feelings you get when your wife is checking your phone…

  -Difficulty breathing
  - Profuse perspiration
  - Weakness
  - Headache

  And when she asks 'who Sheela is', the dry cough starts...
